feature_contract.goal: Preserve stable stereo DirectGPU resource ownership when the OpenXR host restarts, ensuring game-side producer slots never reuse a torn host PID/adapter LUID identity from two independent mapping generations.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: R84 default R29 DirectGPU host identity reader and the portable host-state snapshot regression only; R32 slot-rebind behavior remains unchanged. No change to R26_SAFE world/HUD, lens, GOAL, SkyGlow, input, FFB, DX11, DXVK or localization.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: Before the material repair R29OwnerTryGetDirectTransportIdentity reads SharedPoseState hostPid, hostAdapterLuidLow, hostAdapterLuidHigh as three independent fields without their shared seqlock generation. R32EnsureDirectResources uses that identity to retain or retire GPU slots across host PID/LUID changes, so a torn mixed generation could preserve a stale DirectGPU interop bridge. This is a source-confirmed correctness risk, not a claimed headset reproduction or measured FPS.
trace_stages: OpenXR host SharedWriter publishes the host PID, flags and adapter LUID fields under the SharedPoseState odd/even sequence protocol.
R84 game R29 reads a coherent identity snapshot and enforces HostAlive/HostAdapterLuidValid, header identity and nonzero PID before returning it to R30Support facade.
R32EnsureDirectResources compares the coherent identity with its current DirectGPU ring owner and invalidates ACK state/interop on generation mismatch before rebind.
R33 uses the R32 DirectGPU resolve path, preserving original safe stereo/SBS fallback where host transport is not verified.
subcomponents: Replace independent host PID and LUID reads in active R84 R29 owner with bounded coherent seqlock snapshot and fail-closed identity checks.
Add reusable ABI-neutral host identity snapshot policy with injection point for the game-side MemoryBarrier.
Extend existing x64 host portable eye-extent smoke with stable/odd/racing/reconnect, invalid header, invalid host PID and host-ready negative cases.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: R29 yields only a validated host PID and both adapter LUID halves from one stable shared-memory sequence generation.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Host restart, stale adapter and torn shared state
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Racing, odd, invalid header, missing host-alive, and zero PID snapshots fail closed without publishing a mixed identity to R32, while a completed reconnect accepts only the new process.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Win32 R84 game, fallback game, x64 OpenXR host and active package
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: All exact-SHA DX9Ex Active policy/game/full-chain-compile/host/package, Domain Isolation, HUD Inspector, and Full Source Impact gates pass without HMD runtime claims.

diagnosis.original_evidence: At material parent f8c4e100 R29OwnerTryGetDirectTransportIdentity returned SharedState->hostPid, hostAdapterLuidLow, hostAdapterLuidHigh directly without a shared sequence fence, even as host SharedWriter performs Begin/End around PID/adapter updates.
source_trace: OpenXR host SharedWriter writes host PID and adapter LUID while its shared-memory sequence is odd, then publishes an even generation.
Active game R29OwnerTryGetDirectTransportIdentity is called through R30SupportTryGetDirectTransportIdentity into R32DirectIdentityMatches/R32EnsureDirectResources.
R32 host-generation mismatch invalidates stale ACK and interop mappings before recreating DirectGPU transport; if identity was torn, it could wrongly compare or fail to rebind.
R33 sole game draw dispatcher uses R32 transport choice with conservative SBS fallback outside verified DirectGPU ownership.
diagnosis.root_cause: Three independent PID/LUID reads could observe two host generations, defeating the R32 generation-keyed resource ownership check during a host restart.
alternatives_rejected: Do not relax host ACK, producer-fence or R32 DirectGPU rebind policy as a shortcut.
Do not change unrelated VR rendering, alter input/FFB/World/SkyGlow, or treat a stable snapshot as proof of headset visual acceptance.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Material SHA 3bdd86a62ef52c10f9cb3eba68d5c39354a9f1b9 adds coherent_host_identity.hpp, changes R29 to use its bounded SharedPoseState seqlock reader, and adds race/reconnect/invalid-state behavior tests in vrhost/tests/xr_eye_extent_smoke.cpp.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Source-level portable smoke cases added for odd sequence, concurrent new PID/LUID publication, permanently unstable sequence, invalid version/structSize, unavailable host PID, and missing HostAlive. Host binary execution is pending exact-SHA Windows CI.
